champion.tips: LULU TIPS AND TRICKS When harassing at level 1 and 2, self cast your E if the enemy is trading back with you. If they cannot trade back with you, cast your E on them. Always stand near your ADC as the game goes along. Do not stray too far away from them as they’ll need you to protect them. You can use your Ultimate R to stop the enemy from engaging on to you or your ADC. Right as the enemy gets on top of you, cast your Ultimate R to knock them up and escape. Timing it correctly will prevent damage and also prevent CC.
champion.builds: THE BEST LULU BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR SUPPORT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Lulu Support build, you should take Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Summon Aery as your keystone, followed by Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, as well as Bone Plating and Revitalize in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Ability Haste in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Dream Maker as your first item, followed by Ionian Boots of Lucidity and Ardent Censer. For your last 3 items, you should build Moonstone Renewer, Redemption and finish with Vigilant Wardstone. For the skill order, you want to stick with E - W - Q. Right now, this build has 51.4% winrate over 37 153 matches played. Optional Your second option for Lulu Support build would be to take Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Guardian as your keystone, Font of Life, Bone Plating and Revitalize in the primary tree, and Biscuit Delivery with Cosmic Insight in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health Scaling in defense. The items for the build are Dream Maker, which you should build first, followed by Ionian Boots of Lucidity as your second item and Ardent Censer as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Moonstone Renewer, Redemption and Vigilant Wardstone. The skill order for this build is E - W - Q. In the current patch, this build has a 51.2% win rate over 2 434 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Summon Aery as your keystone, Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, and Bone Plating with Revitalize in the secondary tree, as well as Ability Haste, Adaptive Force, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Zaz'Zak's Realmspike as your first item, then Ionian Boots of Lucidity as a second item and Ardent Censer as a third item. You want to finish the build with Moonstone Renewer, Redemption and Mikael's Blessing. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it E - W - Q. This build is currently sitting at a 47.0% win rate across 2 404 matches played. Off-Meta If you want to try an Off-Meta Lulu Support build in the current patch, try Flash and Heal as your Summoner Spells, Summon Aery, Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch as your primary rune tree, and Bone Plating with Revitalize as your secondary tree. Use Ability Haste, Adaptive Force and Health Scaling as your shards. For items in this build, you want to complete Celestial Opposition as your first item, then finish Ionian Boots of Lucidity as your second item, and Redemption as third item. The last 3 options are Moonstone Renewer, Ardent Censer and Vigilant Wardstone. The ability order for this build is E - W - Q. As of the current patch, this build has a 47.9% win rate over 2 403 matches played. Situational Lulu Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Lulu build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Lulu runes page.
